messages:
clara: FYI starting a canary for v8-hybrid-int4 at 08:10 UTC. this one uses mixed block quant + a small CLM finetune. launching at 2% with intent cohorts.

noah: what's new in the gating? any extra safety metrics?

clara: yes 1) adding a "semantic_drift_score" (embedding distance between baseline and candidate outputs), 2) ensemble-discrepancy rate when paired rerankers disagree, and 3) cost_delta. goal: auto-fallback if semantic drift + quality drop OR large latency regression.

ben: define semantic_drift_score thresholds? we need min-sample guards. small n gives noisy embeddings.

clara: proposal: semantic_drift_score > 0.065 (cohort-weighted) AND (rerank_mrr_delta < -0.01 OR latency_p95_rel > 0.30) => hard rollback. If semantic drift in (0.04,0.065) => soft fallback (route 25% of offending cohort to baseline). require cohort n>=300.

noah: add an "ensemble_fallback" rule: if ensemble_discrepancy_rate > 0.07 for named-entity cohort, route 50% of that cohort to fallback model and trigger extra sampling.

ben: also feature-flag the semantic metric first for 24h so we can tune false-positive rate. and add exponential smoothing to drift (half-life 12m).

clara: sketch config pushed to runner (lean):

```json
{
  "fraction": 0.02,
  "cohorts": ["search","assist","entity-heavy"],
  "min_samples": 300,
  "signals": ["rerank_mrr","latency_p95","semantic_drift","ensemble_discrepancy","cost_delta"],
  "fallbacks": {
    "soft": {"criteria": [{"semantic_drift_range": [0.04,0.065]}], "action": "route_cohort_fraction", "fraction": 0.25},
    "hard": {"criteria": [{"semantic_drift_gt": 0.065, "and": [{"metric": "rerank_mrr", "delta_lt": -0.01}, {"metric": "latency_p95", "rel_gt": 0.30}] }], "action": "rollback"}
  },
  "smoothing": {"half_life_minutes": 12}
}
```

noah: +1. add a cost-safety override: if cost_delta > 0.12 (candidate cheaper) but semantic_drift borderline, prefer soft-fallback and require product sign-off to hard rollback. prevents cost bias from masking quality issues.

ben: ops note: make sure model meta tags include canary_watch=true so infra can pull telemetry quickly. also, if rollback triggers, deploy-bot must automatically tag the previous stable as pinned for 2h to avoid flip-flopping.

sre-bot: deploy event recorded: mdl_v8_hybrid_int4_20260502. monitoring channel #canary-safety. pinned tagging on rollback will be supported by deploy-bot v1.9.

clara: runbook action: I'll add a short flowchart for triage (soft vs hard) and add an example play for ensemble disagreement. runbook-bot please create stub.

runbook-bot: created /runbooks/canary_safety_orchestration.md (stub).

noah: 30m update: fraction 2% -> metrics snapshot: global MRR_delta -0.004, entity-heavy semantic_drift 0.058 (n=420), ensemble_discrepancy 0.075 in entity-heavy, latency_p95_rel +0.12, cost_delta 0.10 cheaper.

ben: drift in borderline band and ensemble_discrepancy > 0.07 -> trigger soft route for entity-heavy (route 25% to baseline) and start importance sampling of the disagreeing queries.

clara: applying soft-route now. will hold and re-evaluate in 20m; if semantic drift increases or MRR stays below -0.01 we escalate to hard rollback.

noah: logging action items: 1) feature-flag semantic_drift, 2) implement ensemble_discrepancy cohort rule, 3) pin previous stable on rollback, 4) add product-approval gate when cost savings large and drift borderline.

deploy-bot: routing update applied: entity-heavy cohort -> 25% baseline. no rollback triggered (window=20m).
